pr_title: Prevents reread/repeated data from Quandl to be enqueued
pr_comments:
I traced higher to found who and why `_current` is set to `null`.

From `FastFowardEnumerator` back to [`enqueable.Enqueue(data);`](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Engine/DataFeeds/LiveTradingDataFeed.cs#L412), `_current` and `_enumerator` are modified by `MoveNext()` methods from three classes: `FrontierAwareEnumerator`, `RefreshEnumerator` and `RateLimitEnumerator`.

`RateLimitEnumerator` only receives `_enumerator` from `RefreshEnumerator` and [pass it forward](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Engine/DataFeeds/Enumerators/RateLimitEnumerator.cs#L77).

When the enumerator has passed the end of the collection at `FastFowardEnumerator.MoveNext()`, `_current` becomes `null` on `FrontierAwareEnumerator.MoveNext()` and sends a [`false`](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Engine/DataFeeds/Enumerators/FrontierAwareEnumerator.cs#L87) signal to `RefreshEnumerator.MoveNext()` that, [consistently sets `_current` and `_enumerator` to `null`](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Engine/DataFeeds/Enumerators/RefreshEnumerator.cs#L64). This step is important, because `RefreshEnumerator.MoveNext()` only polls new data when [`_enumerator` is set to `null` previously](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Engine/DataFeeds/Enumerators/RefreshEnumerator.cs#L54). This results on the 1-hour (two times [`minimumTimeBetweenCalls`](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Engine/DataFeeds/LiveTradingDataFeed.cs#L405)) pattern. 

I think that `RefreshEnumerator.MoveNext()` is ok. If we are not putting my fix at `LiveTradingDataFeed`, we may need to look an alternative at `FrontierAwareEnumerator`.
Does this [commit](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/commit/377bea18e45716d0fe89a7f157df8edf2ce8201) fix #373? 
If so we can close this PR.
@StefanoRaggi's commit almost fixes it; I'm hoping we can find a fix which qualifies uniqueness based on something other than time or doesn't require this uniqueness comparison. This would allow us to have custom data which has multiple points at the same instant of time (like how Ticks are rounded to the second)

issue_context.title: Custom Data Sourcing Emitting Erradically
issue_context.body:
Quandl sources are emitting unpredictably when there are multiple streams together.

Potentially FastForwardEnumerator's check against 'past data' doesn't include the equal case? So that 1 1/2 hours might be a function of the 30min max interval he refreshes at, and then its just emitting the same point over and over again. The enumerator stack is here (https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/options-new/Engine/DataFeeds/LiveTradingDataFeed.cs#L401) and then the FastForwardEnumerator code here (https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/options-new/Engine/DataFeeds/Enumerators/FastForwardEnumerator.cs#L71)
